title: Figure 19: Scaffold-guided tissue regeneration process schematic
description: Illustrated left-to-right process flow captioned "Figure 19. Scaffold-Guided Tissue Regeneration". Labeled stages show "Cells" and "Signaling molecules" combined with a "3D matrix", then "Culture" in a dish, then "Implant" into a human leg bone silhouette, and finally "Healty bone" [sic]. It accompanies the report's explanation of tissue engineering with biodegradable scaffolds.
